title: Front desk can freeze a plan by approving a pause request
what: Freezing a plan is the owner's alone: the member page hides 'Freeze / extra days' from the front desk and the staff-rights words say staff cannot freeze plans. But on Today, 'Requests from the app', a front-desk login can tap Approve on a member's pause request and the plan gets up to 365 extra days, with no role check on the way.
expected: Either only the owner can approve a pause request (the desk sees it and is told to ask the owner), or the staff-rights words and the freeze rule say plainly that the desk may approve pauses members ask for.
how_often: every pause request a front-desk login approves
fix_line: Check the freeze permission before Approve on a pause request, or change the rule and its words
